newsitem.title: FRANCE: EIB 2004 Ecu bond eligible for Sept MATIF delivery.
newsitem.headline: EIB 2004 Ecu bond eligible for Sept MATIF delivery.

text.p: French futures and options exchange MATIF said on Tuesday the European Investment Bank's 5.25 percent April 2004 Ecu bond first issued in January will continue to be eligible for delivery into MATIF's Ecu bond futures contracts.
MATIF said in a statement the EIB eurobond would be eligible for its September and December 1997 Ecu bond contracts.
The EIB bond, the only non-French government bond eligible for delivery, was first added to the list in February to make it eligible for the June 1997 contract.
The EIB bond was described by the lead managers at the time of issue as a "euro" Eurobond. It will be paid in Ecu until a single European currency is launched and then it will be paid in euros.
